Published derived values

Source: R/values.R
soil_values.Rd

Reads the values published by products (models, derivations, expert assessments) on the features, profiles, components and horizons of the Global Soil Data Hub (POST /query/values), page by page, as a typed table: one row per value, with its variable, target, product version and run, status, validity time and depth.

Usage

soil_values(
  soil = soil_session(),
  providers = NULL,
  datasets = NULL,
  variables = NULL,
  domains = NULL,
  measurement_kinds = NULL,
  target_levels = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  valid_at = NULL,
  depth_top_cm = NULL,
  depth_bottom_cm = NULL,
  product_versions = NULL,
  run_ids = NULL,
  statuses = NULL,
  with_geometry = c("none", "sf", "text"),
  include_lineage = FALSE,
  max_rows = Inf,
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

providers

Provider codes of the targets ("isric"). API field providers.

datasets

Catalog dataset codes of the targets. API field datasets.

variables

Variable codes (see soil_variables()). API field variables.

domains

Domain codes of the variables. API field domains.

measurement_kinds

Measurement kinds of the variables ("derived", "modelled", ...). API field measurement_kinds.

target_levels

"feature", "profile", "component", "horizon". API field target_levels.

country

Countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes or names. API field country.

bbox

c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in WGS84 degrees. API field bbox.

valid_at

A date-time (POSIXct, Date or ISO 8601 text): only the values valid at that instant (valid_time_start <= valid_at < valid_time_end, open ends included). API field valid_at.

depth_top_cm, depth_bottom_cm

Depth interval in cm: the values whose depth interval overlaps it (values without depth included). API fields depth_top_cm and depth_bottom_cm.

product_versions

Product version codes. API field product_versions.

run_ids

Run ids. API field run_ids.

statuses

Value statuses: "published", "insufficient_data", "not_applicable". API field statuses.

with_geometry

"none", "text" (the geometry of the target's feature as GeoJSON text in geometry_text, EPSG:4326) or "sf" (an sf object with a geometry column; needs the package sf, else a soilhub_dependency_error). Client-side; sets the API field include_geometry (false for "none"), the form is built locally.

include_lineage

Add the lineage list columns observation_inputs, value_inputs, release_inputs, asset_inputs (what each value was computed from). API field include_lineage.

max_rows

Maximum number of values to read (Inf: all). Client-side; caps the API field limit of each page request.

progress

Report the pages read. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

A soil_table (see soil_table) with soil_layout = "values": value_id, variable_code, variable_name, domain_code, value_type, measurement_kind_code, target_level, feature_id, profile_id, component_id, horizon_id, dataset_code, provider_code, source_support, geometry_kind, (geometry_text), release_code, product_version_code, run_id, value, numeric_value, text_value, boolean_value, json_value (list), value_status, quality_code, valid_time_start, valid_time_end (POSIXct UTC), depth_top_cm, depth_bottom_cm, and the lineage columns. soil_metadata(x)$total_count is the number of values of the selection.

Details

value holds the value in its own type: a double column when every value read is numeric, character for text, logical for boolean, else a list column with each value in its type (json values as parsed lists). The API columns numeric_value, text_value, boolean_value and json_value are kept as returned.

Filters are combined with AND; each takes several values (OR within the filter). NULL means no filter.

Rights: soil:read. Capabilities: query_generic_values; country_filtering for country.

See also

soil_values_summary() to count before reading, soil_publish_values() to publish.

Other thematic reads: soil_health_scores(), soil_health_summary(), soil_resolve_targets(), soil_ttr_flags(), soil_values_summary()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
v <- soil_values(soil, variables = "soc_stock_0_30", country = "KEN",
                 statuses = "published", include_lineage = TRUE)
v[, c("target_level", "horizon_id", "value", "run_id")]
} # }
